| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `background_jobs_list` |
| Method and path | `GET /api/v1/background-jobs/` |
| Business purpose | List (background jobs). Events that need a look, the outbox's health, and decisions on failed events. |
| Requirements | [HIMS-PLAT-007](../../../requirements/platform-and-operations.md#hims-plat-007), [HIMS-PLAT-014](../../../requirements/platform-and-operations.md#hims-plat-014) |
| Actor / permission required | `platform.jobs.view` (See background jobs: waiting, retried and failed events). System roles holding it: Organization administrator. Privileged roles must have passed two-factor in this session |
| Customer / facility scope | Whole hospital: the grant must cover the whole organization |
| Request schema | No body; query: `show` |
| Response schema | 200 list of `OutboxEvent` |
| Validation rules | Query values outside the allowed ones are refused (400) or ignored |
| Allowed current states | Any |
| Resulting state | Unchanged (read only) |

| External calls | None |

| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`); pages of 25 (`page_size` up to 100) |

### POST /api/v1/background-jobs/{pk}/dismiss/

| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `background_jobs_dismiss_create` |
| Method and path | `POST /api/v1/background-jobs/{pk}/dismiss/` |
| Business purpose | Close a failed event that can never succeed; it is never retried. |
| Requirements | [HIMS-PLAT-007](../../../requirements/platform-and-operations.md#hims-plat-007), [HIMS-PLAT-014](../../../requirements/platform-and-operations.md#hims-plat-014) |
| Actor / permission required | `platform.jobs.manage` (Send a failed background event again, or dismiss it, with a reason). System roles holding it: Organization administrator. Privileged roles must have passed two-factor in this session |
| Customer / facility scope | Whole hospital: the grant must cover the whole organization |
| Request schema | `DecisionRequest`: `reason` (required, ≤ 300 characters) |
| Response schema | 200 `OutboxEvent` |
| Validation rules | Fields as in the request schema; anything invalid is 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with each field's problem, and nothing is saved |
| Allowed current states | Any (no state rule) |
| Resulting state | As in the purpose above; the new state is in the response and the audit event |
| Idempotency key behavior | Not taken: repeating the request is refused by the state rules or is harmless |
| Concurrency control | The row is locked while it changes, so two requests never both win |
| Database transaction | One transaction: the change, its audit event and any background event are saved together or not at all |
| Audit event | `outbox.event_dismissed` |
| Outbox / domain event | None |
| External calls | None |
| Timeout and retry policy | No outside calls inside the request; the client should reload before retrying a lost answer |
| Expected error codes | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, 401 `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, 403 `MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED`, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, 404 `NOT_FOUND`, 409 `CONFLICT`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED` |
| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`) |
| Metrics and alerts | Request log line and trace span with `request_id`, status and time; response-time targets checked by the volume check (HIMS-OPS-017); hosted alarms with HIMS-OPS-004 |
| Automated test cases | `common/tests/test_outbox_maintenance.py::test_screen_lists_what_needs_a_look_and_records_decisions`, `common/tests/test_outbox_maintenance.py::test_only_people_with_the_permission_see_or_decide` |
| Backward-compatibility policy | API v1 rules in [the API contracts guide](../README.md#versioning-and-breaking-changes); CI fails when `docs/api/openapi.yaml` differs from the code |
